notes.title: Version 1.1.2 available: Achievement bug fixed
notes.notes: Version 1.1.2 is now available. There was an issue with the unlocking of achievements, which now should be solved. Furthermore we set the FPS target to 60fps, because there were some problems with ridiculous high frame rates

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

the new DanCop version 1.1.0 is now available. 

We fixed some minor bugs, optimized some level details and improved some in game dialogues for better explaination about how some things in the game work. And you have now the option to show the line of sight of the enemies. Also the button hints on the screen will now show the keyboard or gamepad buttons, depending on which device you are using.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34992175/555fc7c7a3dbe854d5db6075fa6dc50489c7556a.png

Sincerly,
Your ScrubbySquirrel Team

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 available with new gameplay feature
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

a new version of DanCop is now available. Beside some small bugfixes and some optimisation in some levels, we added a new gameplay feature. You are now able to hide yourself in a cardbox (sounds familiar?). The cardbox is a consumable, so you can use it only two times in every level, but it can help you to pass some very hard sections. We also had to change the controls for this feature. You can check the controls every time by pressing the right trigger on your controller or F1 on your keyboard.

Sincerly,
The ScrubbySquirrel Team
